bricks.description: MOTION: steady diagonal rain streaks fall at an even natural pace across foreground, mid-ground and background planes, tiny crisp splashes where drops strike dark pavement and roof edges, puddles rippling softly; the subject and the scene stay still.
bricks.when: Any rainy night picture that must breathe.

bricks.description: MOTION: a heavy downpour moving in dense sheets that sweep across the frame every few seconds, water running off edges in thin streams; everything solid in the frame stays completely still.
bricks.when: A storm, a breakdown, a climax.

bricks.description: MOTION: snow falls slowly in three depth planes - large soft flakes near the lens, medium flakes around the subject, fine dust far away - each at its own speed; nothing else in the frame moves.
MOTION: grey ash flakes and a few glowing orange embers drift slowly upward and sideways on warm air, flickering faintly; the rest of the frame holds still.
bricks.when: After a fire, a war, an ending.
